capabilities: Replaces zoomed-out card content with large titles
Builds mind maps with keyboard shortcuts and tree layout
Opens file cards in a side pane
Applies flowchart shapes, border styles and edge types
Adds canvas files to graph view, backlinks and outgoing links
extras: Fork of Advanced Canvas; interface available in English and Simplified Chinese; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; mind-map rearrange does not support canvases containing portals.
intentEvidence: Based on Advanced Canvas by Developer-Mike. Canvas Enhance continues development with a rename, refactoring, and new features.
motivation: Obsidian Canvas is great, but it leaves gaps. Canvas Enhance fills them — without changing the native experience.
problem: Obsidian Canvas leaves gaps: cards are unreadable when zoomed out, mind maps cannot be built from the keyboard, node shapes are limited, and canvas files stay out of the graph and backlinks.

relations.evidence: Based on Advanced Canvas by Developer-Mike. Canvas Enhance continues development with a rename, refactoring, and new features.

summary: Canvas add-on that adds an overview mode, keyboard mind-map building, node and edge styles, side-pane file cards, and canvas metadata in the graph.
